summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）集成学习年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Model soups in the Ensemble area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Model soups: averaging weights of multiple fine-tuned models improves accuracy without increasing inference time”. The page names Mitchell Wortsman, Yair Carmon, Simon Kornblith, Ludwig Schmidt as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
